name: vantovault-2-4-unit-housing-stock-83-metros
title: VanToVault Small Multifamily Housing Stock: Housing Units in 2-4 Unit Buildings, 83 US Metros (ACS 2020-2024)
description: Housing units in 2-, 3- and 4-unit buildings, their share of all housing units, and how many are owner-occupied, for 83 US metros (CBSAs) and their principal cities, from Census ACS 5-year 2020-2024 tables B25024 and B25032.

sources.title: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year 2020-2024, tables B25024 and B25032

citation: Van to Vault (2026). VanToVault Small Multifamily Housing Stock: Housing Units in 2-4 Unit Buildings, 83 US Metros (ACS 2020-2024) (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. VanToVault. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23003739

fields.name: metro
fields.description: Short metro label used across VanToVault datasets (Foothold, DPA survey).

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state of the principal city.

fields.name: cbsa
fields.description: 5-digit Core Based Statistical Area code (July 2023 OMB delineations). Join key.

fields.name: cbsa_name
fields.description: CBSA name as returned by the Census Bureau.

fields.name: acs_vintage
fields.description: Always "ACS 5-year 2020-2024 (ACSDT5Y2024)".

fields.name: total_units
fields.description: B25024_001: all housing units, occupied and vacant.

fields.name: units_2
fields.description: B25024_004: units in 2-unit structures.

fields.name: units_3_4
fields.description: B25024_005: units in 3- or 4-unit structures.

fields.name: units_2_4
fields.description: units_2 + units_3_4.

fields.name: share_2_4_pct
fields.description: units_2_4 / total_units x 100, rounded once to 1 decimal.

fields.name: owner_occ_total
fields.description: B25032_002: owner-occupied housing units, all structure types.

fields.name: owner_occ_2
fields.description: B25032_005: owner-occupied units in 2-unit structures.

fields.name: owner_occ_3_4
fields.description: B25032_006: owner-occupied units in 3- or 4-unit structures.

fields.name: owner_occ_2_4
fields.description: owner_occ_2 + owner_occ_3_4.

fields.name: owner_occ_share_pct
fields.description: owner_occ_2_4 / owner_occ_total x 100, rounded once to 1 decimal: the share of all owner-occupied homes that are in a 2-4 unit building.

fields.name: occupied_2_4
fields.description: owner_occ_2_4 + renter-occupied units in 2-4 unit structures (B25032_016 + B25032_017).

fields.name: owner_occupancy_rate_2_4_pct
fields.description: owner_occ_2_4 / occupied_2_4 x 100, rounded once to 1 decimal: the share of occupied 2-4 unit housing that is owner-occupied.

fields.name: rank_by_share
fields.description: 1 = highest units_2_4 / total_units of the 83 (ranked on the unrounded ratio).

fields.name: rank_by_count
fields.description: 1 = largest units_2_4 of the 83.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: data.census.gov API URL the B25024 values came from; replace B25024 with B25032 for the tenure values.

fields.name: city_name
fields.description: Principal city (Census place), the first-named city of the CBSA. Blank for Bridgeport (not retrieved).

fields.name: city_place_fips
fields.description: 7-digit state + place FIPS code of the principal city.

fields.name: city_total_units
fields.description: B25024_001 for the principal city.

fields.name: city_units_2
fields.description: B25024_004 for the principal city.

fields.name: city_units_3_4
fields.description: B25024_005 for the principal city.

fields.name: city_units_2_4
fields.description: city_units_2 + city_units_3_4.

fields.name: city_share_2_4_pct
fields.description: city_units_2_4 / city_total_units x 100, rounded once to 1 decimal.
